reviews.title: Blown away by how good this company is
reviews.body:
okay i am blown away. this is the best mobile service in the UK . I can use this sim in most places i go to abroad - almost anywhere in Europe and my home country India. I have had zero issues with network - i live in a smallish town in India and i had network coverage there too.
i tried to order a new sim for another work phone it got delivered next day by post . Claps .
I was super curious to see what other brands are offering for different price points - i got a call the next day asking if they can help me with better deals because i was planning to leave them and what the issue was . i did get a better deal.
They have also not increased their prices randomly since like 4 years i have been with them now .

Thank you and thank you . They really care about their customers and it shows.

reviews.title: Not all it's cracked up to be.
reviews.body:
The company states that a new plan will run alongside an old plan until either it's data runs out or the date expires.
This isn't the case and no matter how I tell customer service they seem incapable of sorting out the problem.
I had a 50gb plan with 4gb left on it and 3 weeks left before it expired . I took out a 100gb plan to run alongside because I didn't want to run out of data as I don't have access to broadband WiFi. The new plan started using data immediately whereas the old plan remained the same. It seems with Lebara you don't have a problem until there's a problem and then seem incapable of sorting it.
